headline.en: Inspect a skill before it can run
headline.zh: 让 Skill 运行前，先检查它的行为

sub.en: skvet scans agent skill directories for executable scripts, lifecycle hooks and outbound network patterns, then reports source evidence and a configurable risk verdict.
sub.zh: skvet 扫描 Agent Skill 目录中的可执行脚本、生命周期钩子和外连模式，给出对应源码证据，并按可配置阈值返回风险结果。

body.en: Each finding identifies its rule, severity, surface and source location.
body.zh: 每项发现包含规则、严重程度、行为类型和源码位置。

body.en: Rules examine files in memory; the local scan does not run bundle hooks.
body.zh: 规则检查读入内存的文件，本地扫描不会运行包内钩子。

body.en: Use --fail-on to choose which risk levels return exit code 2.
body.zh: 通过 --fail-on 选择哪些风险等级返回退出码 2。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The example scans the repository’s benign and malicious fixtures and reports their actual verdicts and exit codes. Those intentionally suspicious scripts are read only.
note.zh: 示例扫描仓库内的正常和恶意行为样本，报告实际风险等级和退出码。包含可疑行为的样本脚本只被读取，不会被执行。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Static scan of bundled benign and malicious skill fixtures. Fixture scripts are never executed.
steps.output:
benign-skill: overall=LOW exit=0
  score=0 rules=
malicious-skill: overall=HIGH exit=2
  score=100 rules=SK-HOOK-001,SK-NET-001,SK-SHELL-001,SK-SHELL-002
Scope: static fixture analysis; no hooks, scripts or network calls executed.

body.en: The example scans the repository’s benign and malicious fixtures and reports their actual verdicts and exit codes. Those intentionally suspicious scripts are read only.
body.zh: 示例扫描仓库内的正常和恶意行为样本，报告实际风险等级和退出码。包含可疑行为的样本脚本只被读取，不会被执行。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/skvet.git
cd skvet
go build -o bin/skvet .

limitations.en: Static pattern matching can miss behavior and can flag legitimate commands. LOW is not a guarantee that a bundle is safe.
limitations.zh: 静态模式匹配可能漏检，也可能标记合法命令。LOW 不代表安全保证。

limitations.en: Remote scanning downloads a repository; it does not install the bundle.
limitations.zh: 远程扫描会下载仓库，但不会安装其中的 Skill。

limitations.en: The recorded result covers shipped fixtures, not arbitrary runtime behavior or a complete security audit.
limitations.zh: 记录结果仅覆盖随仓样本，不代表任意运行时行为或完整安全审计。

body.en: A skill is more than its Markdown instructions: installers and hooks may run commands too. Before installing a bundle, read a report that points to the specific file, line and rule behind each finding.
body.zh: Skill 不只包含 Markdown 指令，安装脚本和钩子也可能运行命令。安装前可先查看报告，定位每项发现对应的文件、行号和规则。

body.en: The fetch layer accepts a directory or shallow-clones a GitHub reference. Discovery identifies SKILL.md and supported plugin/hook layouts. Pure shell, hook and network rules produce findings; scoring sorts them and selects the overall level. Text and JSON renderers expose the same result.
body.zh: fetch 层接受本地目录或浅克隆 GitHub 仓库。发现阶段识别 SKILL.md 及支持的插件、钩子布局。shell、hook、network 规则生成发现项，评分模块排序并确定总体等级，文本和 JSON 输出共享同一结果。

title.en: Discover bundles, explain findings, apply the threshold
title.zh: 发现 Skill、解释风险、应用阈值

body.en: The fetch layer accepts a directory or shallow-clones a GitHub reference. Discovery identifies SKILL.md and supported plugin/hook layouts. Pure shell, hook and network rules produce findings; scoring sorts them and selects the overall level. Text and JSON renderers expose the same result.
body.zh: fetch 层接受本地目录或浅克隆 GitHub 仓库。发现阶段识别 SKILL.md 及支持的插件、钩子布局。shell、hook、network 规则生成发现项，评分模块排序并确定总体等级，文本和 JSON 输出共享同一结果。

alt.en: Discover bundles, explain findings, apply the threshold
alt.zh: 发现 Skill、解释风险、应用阈值

body.en: skvet analyzes the bundle itself. Dependency vulnerability tools, runtime sandboxes and signature verification address other parts of installation risk. Use its findings as review input and use --json when another tool needs the full result.
body.zh: skvet 分析 Skill 包自身。依赖漏洞检测、运行时沙箱和签名校验分别处理安装风险的其他部分。可以将发现项用于人工审查，通过 --json 向其他工具传递完整结果。

body.en: --fail-on accepts none, low, medium or high (default high). The score is capped at 100; high-severity findings independently produce HIGH. An empty target with no discovered bundles reports NONE. Rules inspect shell, supported hook manifests and network patterns; source-backed findings matter more than treating the score as a probability.
body.zh: --fail-on 可选 none、low、medium、high，默认 high。分数上限为 100，单项 high 严重度发现也会直接产生 HIGH。未发现任何 Skill 的空目标报告 NONE。规则检查 shell、支持的钩子清单和外连模式；应关注源码证据，不应把分数当作概率。

body.en: scan accepts one target. Local paths work offline; a github.com/owner/repo target requires git and network access. --json preserves detailed evidence, while --fail-on none prints a report without a risk-related failure exit. The last command above intentionally returns 2.
body.zh: scan 接受一个目标。本地路径可离线使用；github.com/owner/repo 目标需要 Git 和网络。--json 保留详细证据，--fail-on none 输出报告而不因风险等级返回失败。上方最后一条命令会按预期返回 2。

changelog.en: Closes two more security false-negatives: the pipe-to-shell env wrapper (curl … | env bash and | /usr/bin/env bash — the canonical portable interpreter shape, which the v0.6.0 fix named but never actually matched) now trips SK-SHELL-002 HIGH; and the comment stripper is now backslash-aware inside double quotes so an escaped \" no longer closes the string and hides a trailing curl exfil behind a quoted #.
changelog.zh: 再修两处安全漏报：pipe-to-shell 的 env 包装（curl … | env bash 与 | /usr/bin/env bash —— 便携式解释器调用的标准形态，v0.6.0 点名却没真正匹配上）现在触发 SK-SHELL-002 HIGH；注释剥离器在双引号内改为反斜杠感知，转义的 \" 不再提前闭合字符串、把紧跟在带引号 # 之后的 curl 外联藏起来。

changelog.en: Closes three security false-negatives: pipe-to-shell absolute-path evasion (/bin/sh, /usr/bin/bash, /bin/zsh now trip SK-SHELL-002 HIGH), a quote-blind comment stripper that hid a trailing curl exfil behind a quoted #, and missing HTTP methods (requests.put/delete/patch/head/options, and fetch with a space) in the HTTP-client regex.
changelog.zh: 修复三处安全漏报：pipe-to-shell 绝对路径绕过（/bin/sh、/usr/bin/bash、/bin/zsh 现在触发 SK-SHELL-002 HIGH）、引号不敏感的注释剥离器把紧跟在带引号 # 之后的 curl 外联藏起来、以及 HTTP 客户端正则漏匹配 requests.put/delete/patch/head/options 与带空格的 fetch。
